findings.issue: runtime/scripts/reduce-state.cjs (renderFrontierSection, lines 2529-2558) adds a `## 10B. FRONTIER` section to the review dashboard on an expansive run only. The section shows frontier size by status, pruned nodes, revisits (visits that covered no new dimension), spent and allotted iterations per budget band, and the active node with its next dimension. deep-review-state-reducer.vitest.ts pins it ('reports frontier size, pruned nodes, revisits and per-band budget on the dashboard', and line 1303 asserts a default run omits it). The review catalog entry never mentions this dashboard output, and its deep-review-state-reducer test row names only the projection, band close and torn-row warning. The research counterpart (deep-research/feature-catalog/convergence/expansive-depth-mode.md line 40, 'Budget And Dashboard') documents its `## 6B. FRONTIER` section, so the two packets differ. The DRV-079 playbook already covers the review dashboard, so only the catalog is missing it.
